reviewConclusions: Each helper call is capped at2geometry misses and16total points; start callback captures source refs and performs zero projection.
Ordinary fixed-home frame.origin is an owned copy of the same immutable navHome, and frame.scale controls both path and range label.
No-home frame.origin is a frozen current-position snapshot, not a fake home; live aircraft is projected against that origin once per paint, while numeric current readouts remain current.
Source/model reset paths clear owned frame/cache through navReset or statusUpdate prime after session owner replacement.
Float coordinates are normalized+0.0 before origin identity comparisons; discrete budgets/zoom validated with modulo0.0 guards.
Published full path draws direct integer points via native clipping with one color selection. All configured points remain present.
